subtasks: Pick up two slices of bread, place them into the toaster, and press the lever down.
Use the right gripper to pick up the rightmost upright bread slice from the rack and place it in the right toaster slot.
Pick up the accessible leftmost upright slice with the left hand, hand it to the right hand, and place it in a toaster slot.
Pick up the top loose slice of bread from the two overlapping on the table with the right gripper. Place it upright into the right toaster slot.
With the right arm, take one of the two remaining upright bread slices from the rack and insert it upright into the right toaster slot.
Press the toaster lever on the front down fully with the right hand, then return both arms to their starting poses.
Transfer just the left of the two slices standing together in the right slot into the empty left toaster slot with the right hand. Keep the other slice in the toaster.
Return both arms to their starting poses with the lever down and the slices in the toaster.
Straighten the leaning bread in the right toaster slot so it slides fully down, then return both hands to their starting positions.
